points.place: 布基纳法索（上沃尔特）雅科
points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 托马斯·桑卡拉出生于布基纳法索（当时称上沃尔特）的雅科，属于马斯人家庭。他的父亲是退伍军人，母亲是穆斯林。桑卡拉在罗马天主教学校接受早期教育，这使他接触到了不同文化和宗教思想。1960年布基纳法索独立后，他继续在博博迪乌拉索的军事学院学习，展现出卓越的学术才能和领导潜力。这段早期经历塑造了他对社会不平等的认知，并培养了他对国家未来的责任感。
points.descriptionEn: Thomas Sankara was born in Yako, Upper Volta (now Burkina Faso) to a Mossi family. His father was a veteran and his mother was Muslim. Sankara received his early education in Catholic schools, exposing him to diverse cultural and religious influences. After Burkina Faso's independence in 1960, he continued his studies at the military academy in Bobo-Dioulasso, where he demonstrated exceptional academic abilities and leadership potential. This early period shaped his awareness of social inequality and instilled in him a sense of responsibility for his country's future.

points.place: 布基纳法索（上沃尔特）各地军营
points.placeEn: Various military camps in Upper Volta (now Burkina Faso)
points.title: 军事生涯
points.description: 桑卡拉在军队中迅速晋升，先后在首都瓦加杜古、博博迪乌拉索等地服役。1970年代，他前往马达加斯加的安齐拉贝接受军事训练，在那里接触到了马克思主义思想。1974年，他在上沃尔特-马里边境冲突中表现出色，获得表彰。1981年，桑卡拉被任命为让-巴蒂斯特·韦德拉奥梅政府的国务部长，但他很快因与政府理念不合而被解职。这段军旅生涯使他积累了丰富的政治和军事经验，同时也让他目睹了腐败和专制统治的弊端，为他后来的政治理念奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Sankara rose rapidly through the military ranks, serving in various locations including the capital Ouagadougou and Bobo-Dioulasso. In the 1970s, he traveled to Madagascar for military training where he was exposed to Marxist ideology. In 1974, he distinguished himself during the Upper Volta-Mali border conflict and received recognition. In 1981, he was appointed Minister of State in the government of Jean-Baptiste Ouédraogo but was soon dismissed due to ideological differences. This military career provided him with extensive political and military experience while allowing him to witness the corruption and authoritarianism that would later shape his political philosophy.

points.title: 革命执政
points.description: 1983年8月4日，桑卡拉通过军事政变上台，推翻了韦德拉奥梅政府，成立了全国革命委员会。他迅速推行了一系列激进的社会经济改革，包括土地改革、教育普及、医疗改善和妇女赋权。他改国名为布基纳法索（'正直之地'），废除了殖民时代的许多特权。桑卡拉还发起了'反懒惰运动'，鼓励人民自力更生。他亲自参与植树造林，计划将布基纳法索转变为绿色国家。在国际舞台上，他拒绝接受国际货币基金组织的条件贷款，坚持独立自主的发展道路。这些政策使他获得了广泛民众支持，但也引起了国内外既得利益集团的强烈反对。
points.descriptionEn: On August 4, 1983, Sankara came to power through a military coup that ousted President Ouédraogo, establishing the National Revolutionary Council. He swiftly implemented radical socioeconomic reforms including land reform, universal education, improved healthcare, and women's empowerment. He renamed the country Burkina Faso ('Land of Incorruptible People') and abolished many colonial-era privileges. Sankara launched an 'Anti-Laziness Campaign' encouraging self-reliance. He personally participated in tree-planting initiatives, aiming to transform Burkina Faso into a green nation. Internationally, he rejected conditional loans from the IMF, insisting on an independent development path. These policies gained him widespread popular support but also provoked strong opposition from domestic and international vested interests.

points.title: 社会改革
points.description: 桑卡拉执政期间，布基纳法索经历了前所未有的社会变革。他推行了大规模的疫苗接种计划，在六个月内为250万儿童接种了疫苗，大大降低了儿童死亡率。他建立了'人民药房'，提供平价药品。在教育方面，他扫除了全国文盲，建立了数千所社区学校。桑卡拉特别重视妇女权利，禁止女性割礼，任命女性担任政府要职，并推动妇女参与政治和经济生活。他还推行了土地改革，将闲置土地重新分配给农民。这些改革显著改善了普通民众的生活条件，但也因触动既得利益而遭到强烈反对。桑卡拉经常亲自下乡，与民众同甘共苦，赢得了'非洲的切·格瓦拉'的称号。
points.descriptionEn: During Sankara's presidency, Burkina Faso experienced unprecedented social transformation. He implemented massive vaccination programs, immunizing 2.5 million children within six months, significantly reducing child mortality. He established 'People's Pharmacies' providing affordable medicines. In education, he eliminated illiteracy nationwide and established thousands of community schools. Sankara particularly emphasized women's rights, banning female genital mutilation, appointing women to government positions, and promoting women's participation in political and economic life. He also implemented land reforms, redistributing idle land to farmers. These reforms significantly improved living conditions for ordinary people but faced strong opposition from vested interests. Sankara frequently traveled to rural areas, sharing the lives of ordinary citizens, earning him the title 'Africa's Che Guevara'.

points.title: 遇刺身亡
points.description: 1987年10月15日，桑卡拉的前战友布莱斯·孔波雷发动军事政变，桑卡拉在瓦加杜古的总统府被杀，年仅38岁。政变得到了法国政府的支持，据信是为了保护法国在布基纳法索的经济利益。桑卡拉死后，他的革命政策被废除，国家重新陷入依赖外国援助的困境。然而，桑卡拉的思想和遗产在布基纳法索乃至整个非洲仍然具有深远影响。他的遇刺使他成为反殖民和反帝国主义斗争的象征，激励着一代又一代的非洲青年。直到2014年，布基纳法索爆发'人民起义'，推翻了孔波雷政权，桑卡拉的遗体才被重新安葬，他的革命理想再次得到肯定。
points.descriptionEn: On October 15, 1987, Sankara was assassinated in Ouagadougou at the age of 38 during a military coup led by his former colleague Blaise Compaoré. The coup was reportedly supported by the French government to protect French economic interests in Burkina Faso. After his death, Sankara's revolutionary policies were reversed, and the country once again fell into dependence on foreign aid. However, Sankara's ideas and legacy continue to have profound influence in Burkina Faso and across Africa. His assassination made him a symbol of anti-colonial and anti-imperialist struggle, inspiring generations of African youth. It was not until 2014, during the 'People's Uprising' that ousted Compaoré, that Sankara's remains were reburied and his revolutionary ideals were once again affirmed.

appraisal.zh: 史学界视桑卡拉为非洲后殖民时代重要的政治思想家与实践者，其理念融合马克思主义、泛非主义与本土传统，形成独特的「桑卡拉主义」，在流行文化中更被塑造成反资本主义与反帝国主义的革命偶像。他拒绝附条件贷款、坚持自主发展道路，土地改革、教育普及与妇女赋权等举措显著改善了普通民众生活。不过，也有研究者指出，他通过军事政变上台，执政方式趋于专制，激进改革触动既得利益，经济上难以持续，外交上亦使国家陷入孤立，其遇刺正折射出这种统治的内在矛盾。
appraisal.en: Historical scholarship regards Sankara as a major post-colonial political thinker and practitioner whose philosophy fused Marxism, Pan-Africanism and indigenous traditions into a distinctive 'Sankarism', and popular culture has cast him as an anti-capitalist, anti-imperialist revolutionary icon. His rejection of conditional loans and insistence on self-directed development, together with land reform, universal education and women's empowerment, markedly improved ordinary people's lives. Yet other researchers note that he came to power through a military coup, ruled in an increasingly authoritarian manner, alienated vested interests with radical reforms, and pursued an economically unsustainable and diplomatically isolating course, his assassination reflecting the contradictions of that rule.

supporter.zh: 桑卡拉被视为非洲独立自主的象征和反殖民斗士。他的支持者赞扬他推行的激进社会改革，特别是土地改革、教育普及和妇女赋权政策。桑卡拉拒绝接受国际货币基金组织的条件贷款，坚持非洲国家应该掌握自己的发展道路。他提倡的自力更生精神、反腐败斗争和环境保护理念，至今仍激励着非洲进步力量。桑卡拉的短暂执政虽然只有四年，但他的政策显著改善了普通民众的生活条件，为布基纳法索树立了独立自主的发展典范。
supporter.en: Sankara is revered as a symbol of African self-reliance and anti-colonial struggle. His supporters praise his radical social reforms, particularly land reform, universal education, and women's empowerment policies. Sankara's rejection of IMF conditional loans and insistence that African nations control their own development paths remain inspirational. His philosophy of self-reliance, anti-corruption, and environmental protection continues to inspire progressive forces across Africa. Despite his brief four-year presidency, Sankara's policies significantly improved living conditions for ordinary people and established Burkina Faso as a model of independent development.

critic.zh: 批评者认为桑卡拉的统治方式过于专制，虽然他自称革命者，但实际上是通过军事政变上台的独裁者。他的政策虽然理想主义，但在经济上缺乏可持续性，导致国家财政困难。桑卡拉的激进改革触动了太多既得利益，引发强烈反对，最终导致他的政权被推翻。此外，批评者指出桑卡拉的外交政策过于激进，与邻国关系紧张，使布基纳法索在国际上孤立。他的遇杀虽然悲惨，但也反映了其统治方式的内在矛盾和脆弱性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Sankara's rule was authoritarian, and despite calling himself a revolutionary, he came to power through a military coup and became a dictator. His policies, though idealistic, lacked economic sustainability, leading to fiscal difficulties. Sankara's radical reforms threatened too many vested interests, provoking strong opposition that ultimately led to his overthrow. Additionally, critics note that his foreign policy was too radical, straining relations with neighboring countries and isolating Burkina Faso internationally. While his assassination was tragic, it reflected the inherent contradictions and vulnerabilities of his rule.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，桑卡拉被视为非洲后殖民时代重要的政治思想家和实践者。他的革命理念融合了马克思主义、泛非主义和本土传统，形成了独特的'桑卡拉主义'。在流行文化中，桑卡拉被塑造成反资本主义和反帝国主义的象征，与切·格瓦拉并列为革命偶像。他的生平和思想影响了非洲进步政治运动，成为后殖民非洲政治反抗的重要参考点。历史学家普遍认为，桑卡拉的执政虽然短暂，但其影响深远，代表了非洲寻求独立自主发展道路的重要尝试，同时也反映了后殖民国家面临的复杂挑战。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Sankara is regarded as an important political thinker and practitioner of Africa's post-colonial era. His revolutionary philosophy blended Marxism, Pan-Africanism, and indigenous traditions, forming a unique 'Sankarism.' In popular culture, he has been portrayed as a symbol of anti-capitalism and anti-imperialism, often compared to Che Guevara as a revolutionary icon. His life and ideas have influenced progressive political movements across Africa, becoming an important reference point for post-colonial African political resistance. Historians generally agree that while Sankara's presidency was brief, its impact was profound, representing a significant attempt by Africa to pursue independent development while reflecting the complex challenges facing post-colonial nations.

self.zh: 我们不是要创造一个依赖援助的国家，而是要创造一个自力更生的国家。
self.en: We do not want to create a country dependent on aid, but a self-reliant country.
